fundamental.summary: ULTA shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 70 days—fundamentals lack bullish catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (15/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is minimal and mixed with no senior conviction; lack of recent news data limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro deterioration with inverted yield curve, crisis VIX (302.56), rising dollar, and FOMC event just passed creates hostile environment for discretionary consumer stocks; 70-day earnings window adds execution risk.
